FIX_1.name: avahi mDNS configuration
details: Root cause: wlan0 has both 192.168.1.167 (WiFi) and 192.168.4.1 (hotspot)
FIX_1.workaround: iPad users should use direct IP: http://192.168.1.167:5000
FIX_1.permanent_fix: Remove 192.168.4.1 alias from wlan0 OR reconfigure hotspot to different interface
